As we all know, the power of the moderator position is an attractive nuisance, and which attracts nuisances from particular parts of reddit. Rather than try to democratize the rather insane notion of giving a few users power over all, we should be able to opt-out of specific moderators who are known to (ab)use their power in any way with which a particular user disagrees.

We'd still have mods to delete spam, but their role would be reduced from mallcops to janitors. If you see one misbehaving, you [click a button](https://i.imgur.com/HNd8YDU.png) and they are *mostly* declawed. I say "mostly" because they still have power over the uninvested and distracted masses.

I don't think this is a perfect idea

Good idea. A flag for mods blocked by x% of subscribers would also give newer users an idea of what to try blocking.

One thing that should be added is that mods should automatically block all other mods of their subverses so the different mods can block the same spam.

I favour my response to moderators, in essence remove them from anything of power. If it is a random job and that they get called upon to serve at random and only if they are in good standing with the community they are far less likely to accrue any kind of power. And they will never be able to be snotty about moderating as it is like having to wash the floor, a responsibility, not an honour.
